name: tft.original.electricity.v1
dataset_attribution: Trindade, A. (2015). ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C58C86

binary_schema.layout: Row-major little-endian raw binary without headers; tensor manifest TSV has no header and columns name, dtype, comma-separated dimensions, filename.

test_sampling: Every complete 192-hour window, stride one hour, within each entity's test frame including its 168-hour context.
sampling_rng: numpy.random.RandomState(seed); choose training candidates then validation candidates without replacement; candidate order is entity ID then timestamp. Persisted manifests are shared across implementations.
epoch_order: For zero-based epoch e, numpy.random.RandomState((seed XOR 0x51F7) + e).permutation(training_sample_count), persisted as little-endian int64 epoch-NNNN.i64.bin and consumed by both trainers. This wrapper adaptation fixes the same shuffle distribution and order across frameworks; native model equations and compiled TensorFlow optimizer remain unchanged.

metrics.paper_pooled: 2 * sum(pinball over windows and horizons) / sum(abs(target) over windows and horizons)
metrics.reference_horizon_mean: Mean over horizons of 2 * sum(pinball over windows) / sum(abs(target) over windows). Matches the pinned script's DataFrame .mean() operations.
metrics.scale: Inverse-transform both target and forecast with the training-only entity target scaler before scoring.
metrics.inverse_scaling_adapter: Use y*scale+mean with the saved entity scaler; fixtures compare to sklearn inverse_transform on a 2D single-feature matrix. This avoids the pinned formatter's 1D Series call on sklearn versions requiring 2D input.
metrics.zero_denominator: Error; undefined normalized risks are never silently replaced with zero.

comparison.report: All seeds including failures, both metric aggregations, paired uncertainty, published-score differences, runtime and memory. No CQR in baseline.
